description: High-depth geographic dashboard of Melbourne's primary storage network.
methodology: Data was filtered to include the 10 critical reservoirs serving Greater Melbourne. Visualization Engineering: Implemented a layered-mark strategy (Aura, Halo, Core) to represent volume magnitude while maintaining 100% legibility of current capacity (%) levels. Geographic centering was manually calibrated for high-resolution industrial dashboard display.
citation: Victorian State Government. (2026). 2026/27 Desalinated Water Order Advice: Technical Analysis. Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action.
